Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: When asked to find gyms within 5 miles of 400 Main St, Point Pleasant, WV, WebSurfer relied on a generic Bing results list that mixed in out-of-state entries (Mount Pleasant, SC), failed to constrain results to West Virginia or verify 5-mile driving distance on a map, and missed The Root Sports & Fitness Center. This led the workflow to validate the wrong candidates (including a mislocated “Ohio WV YMCA”) and ultimately produce the incorrect final answer.
